messages:
Alex T: quick pass — I'm taking primary for the next 8h. saw two pages during my shift, summarizing below.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: 503-surge detected in eu-west-1 (alert #INC-2026-8423) - 14:17 UTC — triggered by router-proxy p95 increase.

Alex T: timeline: 14:12 spike in proxy p95 -> 14:14 first 503s observed -> 14:20 autoscaler kicked (policy: embed-autoscale-v2) -> 14:22 partial fallback to model-variant small-quantized (no config change) -> 14:28 gradual recovery, but tail latency still high.

Maria G: thanks. any customer impact? did any large customers see errors or retries?

Alex T: yes, two customers showed elevated 5xx rates: acme-corp (incidental errors on /v1/generate) and docsbot-svc (high retry counts). Already reached out via pagerduty to their SEs. No escalations yet.

Jamal R: mitigation we ran: reduced batch size for model-route /gptx-large (temporary override) and set KV cache TTL to 30s for hot prefixes. That dropped token-latency p99 by ~120ms. Reproducer steps below:
```
# quick repro check
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO" -d '{"model":"gptx-large","input":"ping"}'
# observe p95/p99 in tracing dashboard
```

Alex T: important config changes (temporary):
- route /gptx-large: max_batch_tokens=1024 -> 512 (applied 14:25)
- kv-cache: default-ttl=300 -> 30 (applied 14:26)
These are in the runtime emergency overrides. Rolling back planned after stability window.

Maria G: runbook references? can we centralize the exact rollback steps for the next shift?

sre-runbook-bot: RUNBOOK: latency-503-surge-v1 — https://internal.redwood/runbooks/latency-503-surge-v1 (step-by-step mitigation, paging matrix, customer comms templates).

Alex T: next steps for incoming shift (action items):
- Maria (secondary) to verify autoscaler metrics and confirm no oscillation by +2h. check stable scaling delta < 10% window.
- Jamal to create a short rollback PR for max_batch_tokens change targeting canary hosts only. include perf test results.
- I will keep the emergency overrides in place until 16:45 UTC or until we observe sustained p95 < 350ms for 15m.

Maria G: noted. I'll also run the KV cache health check script and post results here. link to script: https://internal.redwood/tools/kv-health-check. planning to run at 15:00 UTC.

Jamal R: adding troubleshooting notes — saw transient disk IO on worker gpu-21 around the spike window, possible noisy neighbor. Filed infra ticket INFRA-5421 to check placement policies.

Alex T: customer comms: sent initial note to acme-corp SE at 14:40; waiting on their logs. Docsbot SE acknowledged — asked to route retries to small-quantized until we revert.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: primary/secondary rotation scheduled at 16:00 UTC. Use `/oncall handover` to confirm.

Alex T: handover plan: I'll do a short recap at 15:50 UTC in this thread, include current p95/p99 numbers and whether overrides still applied. If anything changes before then, I'll @Maria G and @Jamal R immediately.

Maria G: ack. I'll own follow-ups on autoscaler and infra ticket.

Jamal R: ack, will draft the rollback PR and ping infra for noisy neighbor follow-up.

Alex T: logs and dashboards pinned (links):
- traces: https://internal.redwood/traces/INC-2026-8423
- metrics: https://internal.redwood/metrics/servers/proxy/eu-west-1
- emergency overrides: https://internal.redwood/runtime/overrides/8423

Maria G: quick note on communication: if autoscaler shows >2 scale events in 10m we'll escalate to infra oncall.

Alex T: accepted. Closing checklist for this shift:
- [x] prioritized customer comms initiated
- [x] emergency overrides applied
- [ ] rollback PR draft (Jamal)
- [ ] autoscaler stability verification (Maria)

sre-runbook-bot: NOTE: attach `/runbook-ack INC-2026-8423` when runbook actions complete.

oncall-bot: PAGE CLOSED: INC-2026-8423 at 14:55 UTC by Alex T (manual close) — monitoring continues.

Alex T: final: leaving a sticky note for the next rotation — double-check node placement for gpu-21 family, and consider pinning high-qps tenants away from best-effort nodes.

Maria G: thanks — will add to rotation notes.

Jamal R: thanks all, see you on the next shift. :wave:
